name: block-item-placement
comment: Placing this task's blocks with their items through use_item (ItemBlock.onItemUse: World.canBlockBePlacedAt → canPlaceBlockOnSide / canPlaceBlockAt, setBlockAndMetadataWithNotify, onBlockPlaced, onBlockPlacedBy): ladders on two side faces of a stone block (canPlaceBlockAt, then onBlockPlaced's metadata from the face) and one refused on its top face (no normal cube beside the cell above), trapdoors on two side faces (canPlaceBlockOnSide), wooden stairs oriented by the player's yaw (onBlockPlacedBy), a fence and a fence on a fence, a cake (ItemReed), a wooden door (ItemDoor), a bed (ItemBed) and a slab. Needs the item behaviour of WP-2.6.
